a script cannot disable or hide the Next / Back button — if the script stopped half-way the respondent would be stranded, so the survey keeps the button working and it would only LOOK disabled. To stop a respondent continuing (an age limit, an eligibility rule, a required format), give the question validation with its message — set_validation, e.g. {"kind":"min_value","value":18,"message":"You must be 18 or above to participate."}: the survey then refuses Next, shows the message, and the server checks it again. A script may still show your own messages and change Next's classes and styles
